subject: math

entries: Unit bars: every unit is the same length: Mia has 2 units and Ben has 3 units, and the ruler checks that each unit box is the same length.
slots.label: Unit bars
slots.studentPrompt: Explain this step in your own words.

entries: Before-and-after: the model shows what changed: Mia starts with 3 units, gives 1 unit away to her sister, and the after bar shows 2 units left.
slots.label: Before-and-after
slots.studentPrompt: Explain this step in your own words.

entries: Worked example: part-whole and difference: the whole class bar has 7 units, with 3 units of boys and 4 units of girls, so the difference is 1 unit.
slots.label: Worked example: part-whole and difference
slots.studentPrompt: Explain this step in your own words.

entries: Watch out: bars must be to scale: Sam draws 1 unit and 2 units with boxes that do not match, while the correct 2-unit bar is exactly twice the 1-unit bar.
slots.label: Watch out: bars must be to scale
slots.studentPrompt: Explain this step in your own words.

entries: A drawing that solves a word problem with bars: one bar for each amount, split into unit boxes, so the relationships in the problem can be seen before calculating.
slots.label: Bar model (model method)
slots.studentPrompt: Give your own example of this term.

entries: One equal part of a bar: in the animation Mia has 2 unit boxes and Ben has 3, and every unit box is exactly the same length.
slots.label: Unit box
slots.studentPrompt: Give your own example of this term.

entries: One whole bar split into parts: the class bar of 7 units splits into 3 units of boys and 4 units of girls.
slots.label: Part-whole model
slots.studentPrompt: Give your own example of this term.

entries: Two bars for the same amount, before and after a change: Mia has 3 units before giving 1 away and 2 units after.
slots.label: Before-and-after model
slots.studentPrompt: Give your own example of this term.

entries: Drawn so lengths stand for amounts faithfully: two units is exactly twice one unit, never a guessed length.
slots.label: To scale
slots.studentPrompt: Give your own example of this term.

title: The model method: bar models for word problems
